video_title: Cavs Practice | Mario Hezonja Media Availability | 10.10.2026

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on adjusting to the length of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: the length is pretty substantial compared to Europe, so probably that.
quotes.quote: Maybe just the length of the guys because I'm obviously, last game I really didn't try to do too much out of the scheme and try to figure it out by my skill or by my talent. But there was maybe a couple possessions that is probably even be normal path to the basket or maybe a foul, but it's just those strips and the just the length. I got to, you know, finish it maybe higher on the rim because the guys are just so, there's so much space, but the length is pretty substantial compared to Europe, so probably that.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja says the biggest adjustment to the NBA has been the length of defenders compared to Europe. He notes he is learning to finish higher on the rim to account for the extra space and reach of opponents.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on his role as an experienced veteran leader
quotes.excerpt: I might be the probably the most experienced one because of the different style of basketball.
quotes.quote: I might be the probably the most experienced one because of the different style of basketball but like so many important games. So just like I'm obviously I don't want to be vocal over everybody. I don't want to, you know, be a smart ass or just like every time, you know, stop or like just say what I see, no. It's mostly by doing the right stuff on the on the court, being in the right positions, screening for guys, getting getting them open. Obviously in the second unit, you know, just being there for everybody. If somebody gets hot, just keep doing it. Run plays for Sam, run plays for JT, you know, get everybody involved. I think also Craig was doing a great job with that. So I think when you add like somebody that is much bigger size but with the same mindset, I think like it just helps the whole whole team going and we get the rest like people, which is probably a goal of coach and the experienced players.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja is embracing a veteran leadership role for the Cavs second unit. He says he wants to lead by doing the right things on the court and getting teammates like Sam and JT open rather than just being vocal.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on James Harden's mentorship and basketball intelligence
quotes.excerpt: James Harden by far. Incredible intelligence on the court that comes from his experience.
quotes.quote: James Harden by far. Incredible intelligence on the court that comes from his experience is one thing, but he's just social intelligence, the stuff that he says. And I see like how much he wants to help me because he understands my story and like what I what I did. So like I I appreciate it but like I'm so thankful that he is, you know, there for me and pushing me. And obviously other guys too, you know, Donovan is there, Donovan knows the team better than than city and organization better than anybody. So everybody is just so supportive of me since I came. I know it's, you know, they can just turn their head on the other way, just another European player, but like they really respect me, my draft, like my whole process, my whole career. So like I'm so so beyond thankful that they are like so appreciative of me and they received me with open arms basically, open mind too.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja is praising James Harden for his mentorship and basketball intelligence. He says he is thankful for how supportive Harden and Donovan Mitchell have been since he joined the team.

quotes.speaker: Mario Hezonja
quotes.summary_phrase: Mario Hezonja on James Harden's evolution and desire to win
quotes.excerpt: I remember him as a 60 point triple double type of player right now.
quotes.quote: Back in the day I was at the twos and he was the two shooting guard, yeah. So for me it's like, oh like I'm one of the best in history at the twos, so let me go and switch position at the one and I'll try to be the best in history at that too. So this is how I imagine him right now that he can be like basically there's two of him. And both of those are Hall of Fame positions that what he's doing. So I guess now like that he wants to win so so bad, I guess, you know, just seeing that the intelligence like bursting out of him, you know, that he wants to get guys going, help everybody, that everything looks good, that everything everybody is competitive, which is going to, you know, today today you have to, everybody wins with the deep roster, you know. So and I think he understands that right now like obviously I remember him as a, you know, a 60 point triple double type of player right now, but like to see him to see this version as well of him, it just speaks wonders about how a Hall of Fame type of player can adapt to different teammates, different teams, different situations, so extraordinary player.
quotes.social_post: Mario Hezonja is impressed by James Harden's evolution as a player. He says seeing Harden adapt from a high scoring guard to a facilitator who wants to win at all costs speaks wonders about his Hall of Fame career.
